dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you?

dialogue.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Got my notes beside me, so quite convenient to talk now. Hoping to keep this call short, though. I'm trying not to spend the whole afternoon on the phone.

dialogue.text: Of course. Before we discuss the account, please provide your identification details.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. What would you like to cover today?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: For this transaction, use my existing holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding. My notes have 2,000 units as the possible sale size. Let me settle the terms before deciding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your objective is to free up money from your existing holding for planned personal expenditure and reduce your exposure to changes in its value. I'll keep the discussion focused and leave room for any questions you want to raise.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks. These days I'm trying to spend more time with family. Work always got something waiting, but cannot keep letting that take up the whole day. Even when we're out together, my phone keeps ringing.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: It sounds as though having fewer interruptions would be welcome. For routine updates, would you prefer a concise telephone conversation rather than a longer discussion?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Short call better lah. Tell me the main point, then leave space for me to ask. If too much information all together, I end up searching through my notes while the person is still talking.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can keep that preference in mind and pause between topics. I recommend reducing your holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund because it releases money for your planned expenditure and reduces your ongoing exposure to interest-rate and credit-related fluctuations.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: But the returns, can you guarantee them or not? I prefer to know what's certain before I decide.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: No, I cannot guarantee future investment returns or promise a particular financial outcome. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept a loss on this sale. Need the money for my planned expenses, so I can bear that outcome. Just let me get back to the right part of my notes. I wrote some family arrangements on the same page, now everything mixed together.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time. I'll pause while you find your place, and then we can finish the call.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Found it already. Do the transaction in Singapore dollars, please. The transaction amount I want is 1,000,000. Use the quantity from my notes that I mentioned earlier lah. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the instruction-taking part of our call. If we need to contact you about administration, we can keep the conversation focused on the relevant point.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That would help. Usually I can step away from work for a short call, just not sit there talking for ages. Thanks for leaving me time to check my page.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You're welcome. Thank you for calling, and enjoy your time with your family.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
